fusions.name: Stampede Ram
fusions.desc: You charge up to 7 tiles into the target, dealing 12 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It deals 5% more for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Herd Quake
fusions.desc: You stamp the ground, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles; if it hits, every ally strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Ploughed Berm
fusions.desc: You plough a furrow and throw up a berm of earth 6 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Slow Temper
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you deal 4% more damage per stack (29% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
